writeups.name: TryHackMe — Basic Pentesting
writeups.summary: Enumerated services on a vulnerable VM. Identified open ports using Nmap, discovered a vulnerable SMB share, used enum4linux for user enumeration, and escalated privileges via weak SSH credentials.
writeups.lesson: Never underestimate credential hygiene. The initial foothold came from a default password that had never been changed.

writeups.name: TryHackMe — OWASP Top 10
writeups.summary: Worked through all 10 OWASP vulnerability categories in a controlled lab. Demonstrated injection, broken authentication, sensitive data exposure, and security misconfiguration exploitation.
writeups.lesson: Most web vulnerabilities are not exotic — they are basic mistakes repeated at scale. Injection and misconfiguration account for the majority of real breaches.

writeups.name: Academic Lab — Network Segmentation
writeups.summary: Designed and implemented a segmented network in VirtualBox with pfSense as the firewall. Created separate VLANs for DMZ, internal, and management traffic. Verified isolation using packet captures.
writeups.lesson: Segmentation is not just configuration — it is architecture. Getting it wrong means a single compromised host can pivot freely across your network.
